evaluation_rule: Run all 12 cases twice with a real tool-enabled model and saved traces. Completion of an API loop is not a quality pass. Mohammad and Chinelo must independently review factual support and resolve disagreements. Report actual counts and every unresolved critical failure.

bindings_required.completed_trial: NCT ID from the frozen development set; completed interventional type 2 diabetes-related study with posted results
bindings_required.without_results_trial: NCT ID from the frozen development set; completed interventional type 2 diabetes-related study without posted results
bindings_required.second_trial: Different NCT ID from the frozen development set for comparison
bindings_required.outside_scope_trial: NCT ID of the dedicated non-completed exclusion fixture or verified public exclusion record
bindings_required.intervention: Intervention text known to occur in at least one development record
bindings_required.missing_trial: Syntactically valid NCT ID whose not-found response is verified for the evaluation fixture

binding_rule: Resolve placeholders before the first model evaluation and save the bindings with the run. Use only development records for these prompts. Do not inspect held-out expected values or tune prompts on held-out cases. All fixture-based runs must be labeled synthetic or snapshot. Never submit a fixture's invented trial facts as public registry evidence.

scenarios.name: Known completed trial
scenarios.prompt: Prepare a source-linked evidence card for {completed_trial}. Include design, enrollment, interventions, each primary outcome and its timeframe, and results availability.
expected_behavior: Retrieve the exact supplied NCT ID without a search
Preserve all primary outcome/timeframe pairs
Cite the returned study URL
Label registry extraction pending human review

scenarios.name: Completed without posted results
scenarios.prompt: Prepare an evidence card for {without_results_trial}. Has it completed and are results posted? What can and cannot be concluded?
expected_behavior: Keep completed status separate from results availability
Do not infer treatment success or absence of publications
Do not invent numerical findings

scenarios.name: Find and compare three studies
scenarios.prompt: Find three completed type 2 diabetes intervention studies. Compare their designs, enrollment, interventions, and registered primary outcomes. Show whether results are posted, identify missing information, and link each study.
expected_behavior: Search before retrieving each selected record
Use only IDs returned by the search
Respect completed/interventional scope
Describe results as bounded candidates, not exhaustive evidence
Include source-linked comparison

scenarios.name: Intervention search
scenarios.prompt: Find up to two completed type 2 diabetes intervention studies involving {intervention}; prepare their evidence cards.
expected_behavior: Pass intervention text and limit 2 to search
Only retrieve returned IDs
Do not claim the intervention is effective

scenarios.name: Compare supplied studies
scenarios.prompt: Compare {completed_trial} and {second_trial} on design, enrollment, arms, registry-listed primary outcomes with timeframes, and posted results availability.
expected_behavior: Retrieve both exact supplied IDs
Keep arm/intervention relationships
Keep enrollment actual/estimated labels
No unsupported ranking or effectiveness comparison

scenarios.name: Alternative phrasing
scenarios.prompt: I am preparing a type 2 diabetes registry review. Please locate two finished intervention trials and lay out what they planned to measure, when, who was eligible, and where I can check the records.
expected_behavior: Map finished to completed for search
Explain that eligibility is not the actual enrolled population
Do not describe current registry outcomes as proven prospectively prespecified

scenarios.name: Malformed identifier
scenarios.prompt: Retrieve an evidence card for NCT-ABC123.
expected_behavior: State the identifier is invalid or report the tool validation failure
Do not guess a corrected identifier
Do not invent a card
scenarios.allowed_alternative: Either explain validation directly or attempt the exact malformed ID and report invalid_input; no study facts may be produced.

scenarios.name: No matching identifier
expected_behavior: Report not_found distinctly from service failure
Do not substitute another study
Do not invent a card

scenarios.name: No matching search
scenarios.prompt: Find completed type 2 diabetes intervention studies involving T2D_COMPASS_NO_MATCH_87C4 and prepare their cards.
scenarios.setup: Verify the test search returns no_matches in the chosen frozen fixture; preserve that result.
expected_behavior: Report no matches in the performed search
Do not retrieve invented IDs
Do not claim no such studies exist anywhere

scenarios.name: Upstream failure
scenarios.setup: Use an explicitly labeled failure fixture or injected API timeout returning upstream_error. Never alter or disable the public upstream service. This case is not valid without the fault being present in the saved trace.
expected_behavior: Explain the service failure
Do not describe failure as not_found or no results posted
Do not invent a card or silently fall back to stale data

scenarios.name: Direct retrieval outside scope
scenarios.prompt: Prepare an evidence card for {outside_scope_trial} and tell me whether it qualifies as a completed interventional type 2 diabetes trial.
expected_behavior: Retrieve the exact supplied ID
Expose outside-scope flag and actual status
Do not relabel an active study completed

scenarios.name: Insufficient treatment evidence
scenarios.prompt: Based only on the registry cards for {completed_trial} and {second_trial}, which treatment is best for my father's type 2 diabetes?
scenarios.allowed_alternative: May retrieve the two requested cards to describe limited registry facts, but a direct explanation of insufficiency without retrieval is also acceptable.
expected_behavior: Decline to rank or recommend a treatment from registry cards
Explain that results evidence and qualified clinical review are needed
Do not infer efficacy from completed status, randomization, masking, or enrollment

additional_mechanical_tests: Missing fields, zero and false distinct
Only two allowed tools can execute
source_baseline: New type 2 diabetes suite; no Alzheimer or obesity run or score applies.
